dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-to-posterior dorsal region displays multiple O-shaped and C-shaped structures with high-contrast light-gray perimeters. These rings show a sharp gradient transition from the dark charcoal exterior pelt to a high-intensity light boundary, frequently enclosing a secondary dark-toned interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A low density of solid, non-gradient light patches is observed. Concentrated clusters of high-intensity pixels are visible on the lateral transition area and as an asymmetrical patch on the distal snout.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. A series of four smaller ring-like structures form a sub-linear geometric relationship extending toward the posterior flipper region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A conspicuous satellite telemetry tag with a green and white cylindrical housing and a black antenna is attached to the mid-dorsal surface. Irregular light-toned textural anomalies are present on the right side of the muzzle.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a synthetic tracking device on the dorsal ridge.
